_about: 03.11.2026: changes to the game's own skills (tools/build_mage.py balance()). Source: Mandragorko's Steam guide 2914998758 and the game's data. Ranks 1-15 only (rows 16-30 are NPC variants). Ops run in order; params are numbered in the order of the Parameters attributes ([1] = Param1). Descriptions: 'desc_en' replaces the English text on every rank (and gets a Russian line), 'desc_ru' replaces only the translation.

Fatality._why: guide: a 10-52% execute is useless, normal hits kill first

Jump Attack._why: guide: slow, single target, no advantage; 05.11 the user: a passive, must not cost mana (the game's data: 4..21 per jump attack)

Poison Arrows._why: guide: outclassed by Splitting and Explosive Arrows; 05.11 the user: low ranks as they are, higher ranks stronger

Unarmed Expertise._why: guide: the worst style; ranks 11-15 added only +4% each

Way of the Battle Mage._why: guide: the weakest buff of its branch
Way of the Battle Mage.desc_en: You get a bonus of [2]% for magic damage, but a [3] point penalty for magic resistance, and a [4] point penalty for indomitable will. The effect lasts for a maximum of [1] seconds.
Way of the Battle Mage.desc_ru: Ваша магия наносит на [2]% больше урона, а вот защита от магии ухудшается ([3]). Кроме того, вы хуже себя контролируете: воля [4]. Эффект заклинания сохраняется не более [1] сек.

Firewall._why: guide: small radius and duration, 30 s cooldown

Magic Blast._why: guide: one of the worst attack skills; data: rank 15 did less than rank 14

Polymorph._why: guide: hits break it, wasteful mana

Life Tap._why: ranks 6-15 needed hero level 90 and did not grow; it is an active skill (the Russian name said passive)

Defensive Posture._why: guide: negligible; data: rank 15 dropped the damage bonus from 18 to 0
Defensive Posture.desc_en: You get a bonus of [4] for melee resistance, and [5] for ranged resistance, but a [2]% penalty for melee damage, and a [3]% penalty for ranged damage. The effect lasts for a maximum of [1] seconds.
Defensive Posture.desc_ru: Вы улучшаете свою защиту от ударов на [4], а от стрел - на [5]. При этом становятся слабее ваши собственные удары ([2]%) и выстрелы ([3]%). Длительность: до [1] сек.

Bleed._why: guide: the description does not give the total; [2] is per second of the bleed
Bleed.desc_en: A successful melee hit has a [1]% chance of bleeding your enemy. For [3] seconds the wound deals [2]% of the hit's damage every second.
Bleed.desc_ru: Удачно нанесённый удар с вероятностью [1]% оставляет кровоточащую рану: [3] сек. она каждую секунду наносит [2]% урона этого удара.

Thousand Strikes._why: guide: the Russian text promises a higher critical chance that does not exist
Thousand Strikes.desc_ru: Вы сможете провести серию быстрых ударов, нанося в [2] раза больший урон и сбивая противника с ног с вероятностью [1]%.

Way of the Ranger._why: guide: it raises the armour rating against shots, not a percentage
Way of the Ranger.desc_en: For up to [1] seconds, your bow attacks do [4] more damage, your armour rating against shots rises by [5] and your heightened reflexes by [6] points, but you get a [2]% penalty for melee attacks and a [3]% penalty for melee resistance.
Way of the Ranger.desc_ru: В течение [1] сек. ваш лук наносит на [4] больше урона, рейтинг брони против стрел растёт на [5], а реакция - на [6] очк. При этом снижается сила ваших ударов в ближнем бою ([2]%) и защита от ударов в ближнем бою ([3]%).

Summon Mastery._why: guide: weak, and the "up to [2] creatures" was false (Param2 read nowhere); Div2Fix SummonLimit=1 keeps Param2 creatures (03.11: the crash with two was the game's BucketID recursion, fixed by BucketGuard); one per summon skill (SummonRecast=0); power x1.5; hero levels 6..40; 07.11 the user: power up to 600% at rank 15 (the game's rank 15 is 225: x600/225); 07.11 the description names the Skull creature and the +2%/level (Div2Fix SkullMastery, SummonLevelPct); 07.11 the Skull creature +70% damage, /1.5 damage taken (Div2Fix SkullDamagePct=70, SkullArmorPct=50), approved; 07.11 SkullDamagePct/SkullArmorPct back to 0: the creature spells are raised in the data instead
Summon Mastery.desc_en: You can keep up to [2] summoned creatures of different kinds at once, and they have a [1]% increase in power. The creature of the Crystal Skull gets this bonus too. Your summoned creatures also deal 2% more damage and take 2% less for every level you have.
Summon Mastery.desc_ru: Вы можете держать при себе до [2] призванных существ разных видов одновременно, и их мощь возрастает на [1]%. Это касается и существа Хрустального черепа. Кроме того, ваши призванные существа наносят на 2% больше урона и получают на 2% меньше за каждый ваш уровень.

Dual Wielding Expertise._why: guide: the text reads as if the off-hand never gets a bonus
Dual Wielding Expertise.desc_en: When fighting with two weapons, your primary weapon does [1]% more damage; the off-hand weapon's damage changes by [2]% (a penalty at low ranks, a bonus from rank 9).
Dual Wielding Expertise.desc_ru: Взяв по одноручному оружию в каждую руку, вы наносите на [1]% больше урона правой рукой. Урон левой руки меняется на [2]%: на низких рангах это штраф, с 9-го ранга - бонус.

Fear._why: ranks needed hero levels 3, 10, 17 ... 101 (7 per rank): rank 6+ was out of reach; the Russian text swapped [1] (level) and [2] (seconds)
Fear.desc_ru: От вас исходят волны ужаса. Все враги уровня [1] и ниже в радиусе [3] м в страхе бегут от вас в течение [2] сек.

Charm._why: ranks needed hero levels 6, 12 ... 90 (6 per rank): rank 8+ was out of reach

Blind._why: ranks needed hero levels 10, 13 ... 52: the last ranks were out of reach

Destruction._why: ranks needed hero levels 10, 15 ... 80: rank 9+ was out of reach; trainers sold only up to 8
Destruction.desc_en: Your magical attacks do [1]% more damage.
Destruction.desc_ru: Ваши боевые заклинания наносят на [1]% больше урона.

Summon Ghost._why: summons too weak: healing x1.5 (03.11: duration x1.5 and level +4 undone while the transparent ground / summon delay is investigated); 07.11 the user: creature level up to 46 at rank 15 (game 40; +0..+6 spread over the ranks)

Fireball._why: too strong after the rest of the balance: damage x0.8 (Ice Bolt and Frost Nova keep their values, taken from the original)

Wisdom._why: 03.11 user: +2% experience per rank (30% at 15) was not worth a skill point; now 4% at rank 1 .. 50% at 15

Fatigue Consumption._why: 05.11 the user: rank 10 needed level 48, rank 15 level 72; the only trainer step was 10

Confusion._why: 05.11 the user: rank 9 needed level 47, rank 15 level 77; the only trainer step was 9

Way of the Wise Wizard.desc_en: You get a bonus of [3] for magic resistance, and [4] for indomitable will, but a [2]% penalty for magic damage. The effect lasts for a maximum of [1] seconds.
Way of the Wise Wizard.desc_ru: Ваша магия наносит меньше урона ([2]%), зато защита от магии улучшается на [3]. Кроме того, вы лучше себя контролируете: воля увеличивается на [4]. Эффект заклинания сохраняется не более [1] сек.

Battle Rage.desc_en: You get a bonus of [2]% for melee damage, but a penalty of [3] for melee resistance. The effect lasts for a maximum of [1] seconds.
Battle Rage.desc_ru: Ваши удары наносят на [2]% больше урона, однако защита от ударов ослабевает ([3]). Продолжительность действия: до [1] сек.

Explosive Arrows._why: 05.11 the user: its damage does not scale; x1 at rank 1 growing to x1.6 at rank 15

Summon Undead._why: 07.11 the user: creature level up to 46 at rank 15 (game 40; +0..+6 spread over the ranks)

Summon Demon._why: 07.11 the user: creature level up to 46 at rank 15 (game 40; +0..+6 spread over the ranks)

creature_magicblast._why: 07.11 the user: the creature gets these spells up to rank 10 only, so rank 10 has the strong values (rank 15 of before) and ranks 11-15 repeat it; 07.11 the user: damage -30%

creature_magicmissile._why: 07.11 the user: the creature gets these spells up to rank 10 only, so rank 10 has the strong values (rank 15 of before) and ranks 11-15 repeat it; 07.11 the user: damage -30%

creature_fireball._why: 07.11 the user: the creature gets its spells up to rank 10 only: the game's curve of ranks 1-15 squeezed into 1-10 (rank 10 = 1115 damage, 20% fire), ranks 11-15 repeat rank 10; 07.11 the user: damage -30%

Curse._why: 07.11 the user: a 1 s cooldown is too cheap, 15 s at rank 1 .. 10 s at 15

trainer_extra._about: 03.11: higher caps of game skills, each purchase right after the after_cap one (the trainer offers them in list order); Div2Fix TrainerExtra<n> adds them to loaded saves

trainer_ladders._about: 03.11: these skills stopped at 5-8 (or were sold by no trainer): every mage trainer sells 10/13/15 at the game's usual prices; Div2Fix TrainerExtra<n> adds them to loaded saves

trainer_remove._about: 03.11: the expansion sold these odd caps (7/8) before the usual 10/13/15: removed (Div2Fix TrainerRemove does it in loaded saves)

_limbs_about: 07.11 the user: the necromancer creature (Crystal Skull) parts. "limbs" = {item subtype: factor} on every stat mod of those items (rpgstats_itemprototypes.xml, both episodes). Severed Arms x2: Undead melee and Dragonelf magic damage +60..150% -> +120..300%, Goblin +20..110% -> +40..220% (health, melee, magic), Necromancer health +40..140% -> +80..280%.
